title: 第7章 最好的朋友（上）
slug: 从素晴开始成为海贼王
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

入夜，悠悠所在的旅馆房间里。

今晚的悠悠显得格外亢奋，甚至主动把惠惠拉到床边，兴冲冲地讲起了白天的经历。

“你知道吗？你知道吗？他又请我喝果汁了！又请我了！他果然是个很温柔的人啊！”

惠惠总觉得有哪里不对劲，便让悠悠把当时的情况一五一十地复述了一遍。

等悠悠满脸陶醉地描述完整个场景，惠惠一脸无语。

不管怎么想，这家伙都是被人家当成泡在公会里的乞丐了吧？

要不要提醒她一下……算了，真捅破这层窗户纸，她绝对会哭的。

“……然后呢？”惠惠叹了口气。

“然后他回旅馆取了几个坏掉的假人模特，又在武器店卖掉了一柄铁剑，换了一把看起来还算不错的弯刀。”

惠惠的眉头微微皱起。

“再然后他就出城了。他用假人模特当诱饵，一口气干掉了五只巨型蛤蟆。回到公会的时候，他看起来累得不行，点了好多吃的，一点没剩全吃光了。他还特意看了眼我常坐的那张桌子。我觉得……他应该是想请我再喝一杯的，可惜当时我没坐在那里……”

惠惠此刻的表情已经不能用惊愕来形容了，然而悠悠还没说完。

“然后他就回旅馆了。说起来，他和我们住得还挺近呢！要不我们买点什么礼物去看看他……”

话音未落，惠惠一把抓住悠悠的衣领，用力推搡起来，试图让这个家伙稍微清醒一点。

“够了！你真的够了！你终于还是迈出这一步了吗？你知道你这种行为叫什么吗？跟踪！尾随！你是痴女吗？”

“才不是！你不懂，那个小哥肯定和我一样，只是不擅长和人打交道……”

听着悠悠对林北的各种揣测与妄想，惠惠已经彻底无力了。

不过有一点她至少可以确定。

那个叫林北的家伙，应该不是什么坏人。

不仅如此，他还是个非常勤勉努力的人。

甚至，他可能还是个过分心软的滥好人。

总之，至少不用为悠悠可能结交到什么奇怪的朋友而担心了。

有机会的话，还是替这个笨蛋去向人家道个歉好了。

第二天一早，林北如往常一样来到冒险者公会，接取讨伐巨型蛤蟆的任务。

招待大姐姐似乎很欣赏他：“很期待林北先生能一直在阿克塞尔活跃下去呢。”

林北犹豫了一下，还是决定开口。

At night, in the hotel room where Yoyo is.

Yoyo seemed particularly excited tonight, and even took the initiative to pull Megumin to the bedside and excitedly talked about her experiences during the day.

"Do you know? Do you know? He invited me to drink juice again! He invited me again! He is indeed a very gentle person!"

Huihui always felt that something was wrong, so she asked Yuyou to recount the situation in detail.

When Yuyou described the whole scene with a face full of intoxication, Huihui was speechless.

No matter how you think about it, this guy is regarded as a beggar who hangs out in the guild, right?

Do you want to remind her... forget it, she will definitely cry if this layer of window paper is really broken.

"...Then what?" Megumin sighed.

"Then he went back to the hotel to pick up a few broken mannequins, and sold an iron sword at a weapons store and replaced it with a scimitar that looked pretty good."

Megumin's brows wrinkled slightly.

"Then he left the city. He used a mannequin as bait and killed five giant toads in one go. When he returned to the guild, he seemed very tired. He ordered a lot of food and ate all of it. He even looked at the table where I usually sit. I think... he probably wanted to buy me another drink, but unfortunately I wasn't sitting there at the time..."

Megumin's expression at this moment can no longer be described as shocked, but Yuyou hasn't finished speaking yet.

"Then he went back to the hotel. Speaking of which, he lives quite close to us! How about we buy some gifts and go see him..."

Before she finished speaking, Huihui grabbed Yoyo's collar and pushed her hard, trying to make this guy wake up a little.

"Enough! You really have enough! Have you finally taken this step? Do you know what your behavior is called? Stalking! Following! Are you a slut?"

"No! You don't understand. That guy must be just like me, but he's just not good at dealing with people..."

Listening to Youyou's various speculations and delusions about Lin Bei, Huihui was completely powerless.

But she was at least certain of one thing.

That guy named Lin Bei shouldn't be a bad person.

Not only that, he is also a very hard-working person.

He might even be an overly soft-hearted person.

In short, at least you don't have to worry about any strange friends Yoyo might make.

If you have a chance, you'd better apologize to this idiot.

Early the next morning, Lin Bei came to the Adventurer's Guild as usual to accept the task of conquering the giant toad.

The hostess seemed to appreciate him very much: "I look forward to Mr. Lin Bei continuing to be active in Axel."

Lin Bei hesitated for a moment, but decided to speak.
